a: A Pod is the smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes.
ClusterIP exposes a service on an internal cluster IP.
Ingress routes external HTTP traffic to services.
Secrets store sensitive data; still protect etcd and access.
Deployments support rolling updates and rollbacks.
HPA scales replicas based on metrics like CPU.
Namespaces isolate resources within a cluster.
Liveness probes restart containers that are stuck.
Readiness probes remove pods from traffic until ready.
